Jain Scholar to Present 'Mahavir Nirvana Katha' at Bharat Mandapam

Rajiv Jain CA will present the 'Mahavir Nirvana Katha' at Bharat Mandapam on November 15. The event aims to bring the ancient city of Pawapuri to life.
